title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Boston University
description: Boston University's linear campus along Commonwealth Avenue creates a unique late-night culture centered on accessible diners, student-run cafes, and reliable pizza spots that stay open well past midnight.

cards.title: T. Anthony's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: The West Campus Pizza Staple
cards.notes: Visit this iconic spot across from West Campus for a late-night slice. It is famous for its walls covered in photos of BU athletes and its 2:00 AM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A legendary pizzeria across from West Campus known for its sports-themed decor and late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: T. Anthony's Pizzeria is located across from Boston University and is open until 2:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: T. Anthony | Pizza Restaurant & Delivery | Sports Bar | Boston, MA

cards.title: El Jefe's Taqueria
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mexican on Comm Ave
cards.notes: Head here for burritos and tacos until the early morning. It is a popular destination for students looking for a substantial meal after a long study session.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican eatery on Commonwealth Avenue serving tacos and burritos until 3:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe's Taqueria at Boston University is open daily from 8:00 AM to 3:00 AM.

cards.title: Warren Late Nite Café
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Dining Hall After-Hours
cards.notes: Use your dining points for late-night snacks at this central campus hub. It serves as a primary social and refueling spot for freshmen living in Warren Towers.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus late-night dining option located within the Warren Towers residential complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Warren Late Nite Café is an on-campus dining location at BU that provides late-night food options for students.
cards.source_title: The Fresh Food Co. at Warren Towers | Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 2:00 AM during the academic semester.

cards.title: City Convenience
cards.subtitle: West Campus Midnight Essentials
cards.notes: Stop by this West Campus convenience store for snacks, drinks, or microwave meals. It is a go-to for students in the Claflin, Sleeper, and Rich Hall dorms.
cards.short_summary: A university-operated convenience store in West Campus providing late-night essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: City Convenience at Sleeper Hall is open daily until 1:00 AM.

cards.title: Raising Cane's
cards.subtitle: The West Campus Chicken Run
cards.notes: Grab a Box Combo at this popular chicken finger chain. Its location near West Campus makes it a frequent stop for students before the 11:00 PM closing.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain on Commonwealth Avenue known for chicken fingers and signature sauce.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 949 Commonwealth Ave is open daily until 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers | Dining Services

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookies Delivered Late
cards.notes: Order warm cookies for delivery or pick them up at the storefront. This is the classic choice for satisfying a late-night sweet tooth during finals week.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in warm cookies delivered late into the night, popular with students.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies serves and delivers warm treats until late night, typically 1:00 AM or later.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM or later most nights.

cards.title: Tasty Burger
cards.subtitle: Fenway's Late-Night Grill
cards.notes: Walk toward Fenway for a burger and fries at this local favorite. It stays open until 2:00 AM, making it a reliable option for East Campus residents.
cards.short_summary: A popular burger joint near the Fenway area that serves food until 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Tasty Burger at 1301 Boylston St is open daily until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Mugar Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: The 24-Hour Finals Hub
cards.notes: Find a quiet cubicle or a group table in BU's main library. During finals, it transitions to 24-hour operation to support all-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary library for Boston University, offering extended hours and 24-hour access during exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Mugar Memorial Library operates on a 24-hour schedule during study days and final exams.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours during finals; regular semester hours typically until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Bay State Underground
cards.subtitle: East Campus Comfort Food
cards.notes: Visit the basement of the Yawkey Center for burgers and comfort food. It provides a cozy, subterranean atmosphere for late-night dining in East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused restaurant in the basement of the Yawkey Center offering comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Bay State Underground is a late-night dining location at 100 Bay State Road.
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal hours; typically open late during the academic year.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: The Reliable Delivery Run
cards.notes: Order a late-night pizza using your Convenience Points. This location is a staple for delivery to West Campus dorms during late-night gaming or studying.
cards.short_summary: A reliable pizza delivery option that accepts BU Convenience Points and stays open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's Pizza at West Campus is open until 2:00 AM and accepts Convenience Points.
